## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, before/after behavior, and linked issue. Keep one cohesive change per PR.

## Validation

- Commit tested:
- Commands and results:
- OS / app / harness actually exercised:
- Not tested / known limits:

For desktop or harness changes, include a minimal reproducible scenario, expected and observed result, and sanitized evidence. Protocol mocks are not real model inference; CI packaging is not physical Windows/macOS validation. Link large recordings instead of committing them.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Relevant regression tests pass; failures and skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and both READMEs are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, personal sessions, captures, build output, or recordings in the diff.
- [ ] Release/version changes are intentional; ordinary fixes do not publish releases.
